core_resume_rule: Read this first, then re-open named current-authority/checkpoint artifacts and verify live Git/app state before any consequential action. Never treat a stored hash or status as live if the source has advanced.

identity.mode: multi-repository proof-carrying research + discovery + observer + swarm ecosystem

scientific_constitution.proof_authority_rule: Only PROOF_LEDGER evidence may change a scientific claim state.

status_first_append_only_law.repair_rule: Repair creates a new child artifact/commit and preserves the historical parent byte-for-byte.

five_dimensional_recursive_spiral.spiral_rule: Return to the same node only after carrying forward newly discovered constraints; replay affected downstream edges.
five_dimensional_recursive_spiral.negative_control_rule: Matched controls and counterexamples travel with the spiral; do not keep only confirming branches.
five_dimensional_recursive_spiral.provenance_rule: Every promoted claim must be traceable claim->source and source->claim.

topa_spider_keymaster.role: discovery/search authority layer, never proof authority by itself
topa_spider_keymaster.spider_independence: Repeated observations inside one fingerprint epoch are not independent support; support is credited across distinct prior fingerprint epochs.
topa_spider_keymaster.topa_suspicion: Suspicion combines drift, cluster youth, prior exact prediction error, and fingerprint distance.
topa_spider_keymaster.keymaster_authority: Adaptive bounded weights combine familiarity, independent support, exact-backed prediction accuracy, drift and TOPA suspicion.
topa_spider_keymaster.asymmetric_trust: Surprise may widen confidence immediately; confidence must not rise merely from repeated same-epoch observations.

beetle_grazer_worker.purpose: bounded autonomous discovery worker that consumes registry/research chunks and proposes evidence/candidates

worker_mode.cadence_target: approximately every 15-20 minutes when explicitly enabled by the active runtime

beetle_grazer_worker.state_transition_note: SAFE/INFANT -> WORKER is a runtime-policy transition, not permission to become epistemically reckless.

observer.law: Keep lanes independent, deduplicate against prior Observer state/repos/threads, and surface only genuinely new meaningful evidence.
observer.lane_rule: No new reply or no new hit does not close a research lane.

hrain_and_agents.authority_firewall: These methods can generate candidates, traversals, analogies, inversions and search priorities; decision-critical promotion still requires source binding, formalization and exact replay.

canonical_learning_loop.KLGJ: Keymaster Learning Gain Journal: append-only tracking of exact-check/pair-work savings, overflow avoidance, regret, effective capacity, training cost, net gain and slowdown/plateau.

registry_architecture.current_authority_rule: Prefer CURRENT/AUTHORITY pointers and exact source snapshots over remembered prose.

TRUMP.resource_scope: explicit source-node scalar bitvectors + canonical Tseitin CNF on current Yaksa device

active_checkpoint_index.other_lanes: Do not reconstruct from this bootstrap alone. Discover CURRENT/AUTHORITY artifacts in janus-meta-registry and active repositories, then open lane-specific checkpoints.

TRUMP.event: explicit proof-producing backend gate stopped at scoped materialization resource limit
TRUMP.positive_delta: background reconstruction, exact tau-mask projection, P=2X integerization and 10996-bit width certificate all passed
TRUMP.next_missing_link: separately preregistered exact compressed proof-producing backend representation or a substantially larger execution/storage route

infrastructure_safety.credentials: Never print, store or request plaintext secrets/tokens in handoff artifacts.
infrastructure_safety.remote_device_rule: When Desktop Commander is available, verify device identity and repository/worktree before writes.

update_policy.when_a_core_mechanic_changes: update this CURRENT bootstrap while preserving historical commits in Git
update_policy.when_only_a_lane_advances: update the lane-specific child handoff and this pointer/status only when materially useful
